goal: A fresh coding-agent chat can resume this job-application project from continuously maintained, selectively retrieved project memory.
authorization: Lohith explicitly requested implementation in the current conversation, after defining the memory, checkpoint, observation and commit requirements.
scope: Project memory and coding-work observations only. Preserve application code, existing dirty work and original agreement. No paid model runs, application submissions or pushes.

design.storage: Small versioned JSON records with stable IDs and explicit links; immutable record revisions; SQLite search/graph index rebuilt from those records. Raw operational events stay local in daily JSONL files.
design.retrieval: Start with project overview, current checkpoint, operating rules and pointers. Read a specific record or exact source section only when needed.
design.updates: Record decisions and changes immediately. Reject stale revisions. One coherent change per explicit-path commit. User acceptance is distinct from technical completion.
design.observations: Local CLI event logging plus Codex startup/tool/stop hooks. Hook trust is controlled by Codex/user, never bypassed. Agent-maintained semantic decisions cannot be inferred automatically from tool events.
design.portability: Python standard library and PowerShell launcher. No specific model required. Any terminal agent can query the same project records. Hooks are a Codex adapter, not a universal sandbox.

steps.work: Implement record storage, revisions, search, linked impact lookup and bounded startup briefing.
steps.evidence: Fresh-process recovery, stale-write rejection, dependency traversal, source integrity checks.

steps.work: Add local observation hooks and setup for the next Codex session.
steps.evidence: Synthetic lifecycle events exercise logging and briefing; live trust/dispatch remains separately visible.

steps.work: Import the agreed plan with exact source references, seed honest checkpoint states and install concise startup instructions.
steps.evidence: Source coverage and hashes; fresh CLI reads only relevant records; inspect handoff and focused commits.

limits: No guarantee of semantic correctness or enforced human identity.
Untrusted/unsupported hooks cannot observe Codex automatically.
Old application implementation claims are historical until freshly inspected.
Detailed storage grows, while the startup context stays bounded.
